title: Donna's Baked Eggs and Cheese
ingredients: 1 pound shredded cheese - Monterey Jack, Muenster, or Cheddar Jack
directions: Beat together eggs, sugar, milk and salt. Add Monterey Jack or Muenster cheese, cream cheese and cottage cheese and the margarine. Mix well, then add the well-combined flour and baking powder. Pour into greased 9 x 13 x 2 inch baking pan. Bake at 350º 50 to 60 minutes. If made ahead and refrigerated, bake 1 hour or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cut into 3 inch squares. Serves 12.
